summary_1line: Krishna travels toward Hastinapura as envoy; Dhritarashtra orders lavish honors and gifts, but Krishna ignores the ornate pavilions prepared for him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna descends from his chariot at sunset in Vrikasthala, the sky red behind him as villagers and Brahmanas gather to greet him.
Along the road to Hastinapura stand glittering gem-studded pavilions filled with garlands, dancers, and rich gifts awaiting Krishna.
Krishna’s chariot passes the magnificent pavilions without stopping, their jewels shining while he rides straight toward the Kuru capital.
